key_insight: LongZero improves LLM long-context reasoning through self-generated tasks, without external training data or stronger teacher models.
engineering_relevance: The approach offers a way to reduce dependence on costly annotated datasets and external corpora when training long-context reasoning models.
method: Generate questions, answers, and supporting evidence in a compact structured form.
Expand the evidence into long multi-document contexts.
Train with GRPO on self-written multi-hop reasoning and multi-round retrieval tasks.
evidence_signal: Across two LLMs and five long-context reasoning benchmarks, the abstract reports generalization to real tasks and performance exceeding both baselines, including RL using externally sourced synthetic data.
watch_item: Self-generated answers and expanded evidence require consistency checks; the abstract does not quantify their reliability or training cost.
paper_title: LongZero: Enhancing Long-Context Reasoning in LLMs from Zero Data
